verdict.rationale: Unleash's impact-metrics docs describe safeguards that automatically pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics such as error rate or latency cross a threshold. They also describe gating milestone progression on those metrics, inside its release-management and release-template framework. Missing for 10: detail on how metrics are ingested and how thresholds are configured, explicit automatic rollback to a prior state (the docs say "pause" or "disable"), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
